# Directional Movement Index

*+DI and -DI directional movement with ADX trend strength.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Directional Movement Index** under **Trend**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ADX smoothing | int | `14` |
| DI length | int | `14` |
| ADX color | color | `"#F50057"` |
| +DI color | color | `"#2962FF"` |
| -DI color | color | `"#FF6D00"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/dmi.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Directional Movement Index", shortTitle: "DMI", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const smoothing = input.int("ADX smoothing", 14, { min: 1, max: 50 }), diLength = input.int("DI length", 14, { min: 1 });
const d = ta.dmi(diLength, smoothing);
plot(d.adx, { title: "ADX", color: input.color("ADX color", "#F50057", { group: "Style" }) });
plot(d.plus, { title: "+DI", color: input.color("+DI color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
plot(d.minus, { title: "-DI", color: input.color("-DI color", "#FF6D00", { group: "Style" }) });
```
